get.description:
Get the list of available models.

Response format is determined by request headers:
- Anthropic format: include x-api-key and anthropic-version headers
- Gemini format: include x-goog-api-key header or key query param
- OpenAI format: default
Return available model list in Gemini API format.

post.description:
Create a model response based on conversation history. Supports streaming and non-streaming responses.

Compatible with OpenAI Chat Completions API.

OpenAI Responses API for creating model responses.
Supports multi-turn conversations, tool calls, reasoning, and more.
OpenAI Responses API for compacting long conversations.

Submit an asynchronous image generation task. Supports OpenAI-compatible format (DALL-E) and vendor-native formats.

Returns a task ID for status polling via GET.

content.text: 一副典雅庄重的对联悬挂于厅堂之中，房间是个安静古典的中式布置，桌子上放着一些青花瓷，对联上左书“义本生知人机同道善思新”，右书“通云赋智乾坤启数高志远”， 横批“智启通义”，字体飘逸，在中间挂着一幅中国风的画作，内容是岳阳楼。

Jimeng native API format for video generation.

post.description:
Submit a video generation task (generic format).

Supports multiple models (Kling, Hailuo, Sora, etc.), selected via the model parameter.
Supports text-to-video (prompt param) and image-to-video (image param).

Returns a task ID for status polling via GET.

get.description:
Query the status and results of a video generation task.

Task states:
- queued: waiting
- in_progress: generating
- completed: done
- failed: error
